top_signals.title: US Tech Stocks Poised to Erase Midterm Loss as AI Trade Returns
top_signals.summary: US stocks extended gains Wednesday, with the technology-heavy Nasdaq 100 index briefly erasing losses suffered after the US midterm election, as excitement over the artificial intelligence trade returned.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Why Anthropic’s mega IPO could offer hope to Nscale after listing doubts
top_signals.summary: Anthropic’s $1.4 trillion stock market debut could give Nscale’s troubled $35bn listing plans a “modest lift”, according to analysts, although the British AI firm may still be forced to postpone its flotation until next year. top_signals.title: European Stocks Hit Record High as Energy and Tech Rebound
top_signals.summary: European stocks set a fresh record as rebounding energy and tech shares picked up the baton to extend a period of outperformance.
